description: Agent Negotiation: submit one proposed agreement: each item of value at risk with its value, whether it is handed over before the counterparty pays and whether it can be taken back, each payment from the counterparty with its amount and timing (upfront, on a milestone, on delivery or after), and the recovery terms: deposit, escrow, termination for default with a cure period, walk-away fee, late fee, dispute path and ownership until paid. The signed report sets the value handed over before payment against what secures it, lists the recovery paths and every exposure left unaddressed, and names unsecured value and no remedy for default, then unvalued exposures, nothing owed on a walk-away, no termination right, no dispute path, no late fee and ownership passing before payment, with the fix for each. A spend cap design is wever_exposure-cap-check, liability for agent error is wever_liability-terms-check and escrow terms are wever_escrow-quote. Verdict exposed, risk_gaps, risk_unverified or risk_covered. POST /api/negotiation-risk-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-negotiation-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-negotiation/.
